company_workspaces.company_management: authenticated membership-bound actions; no reusable guest credentials returned

member_calendar_consent.identity: fresh verified member consent; matching Google email
member_calendar_consent.preferences: member-owned destination, busy calendars and hours
member_calendar_consent.removal: fences new host assignments; accepted bookings retain snapshots
member_calendar_consent.withdrawal: local grant deletion; account-scoped control survives leaving; not provider token revocation

team_booking_links.calendar_authority: explicit accounts connected to the selected profile; company membership grants no calendar access
team_booking_links.admission: teamRevision and intakeRevision; teamHostId only for choose
team_booking_links.collective_event: one organizer event with selected staff invited as attendees

meeting_durations.new_request_without_duration: saved link default; older callers remain supported
meeting_durations.reschedule: retains accepted duration and assigned hosts, including retired choices
meeting_durations.availability_for_accepted_booking: guest capability or authenticated organizer action

guest_change_policy.accepted_policy: snapshot retained after link edits; replacement deadlines relative to new start
guest_change_policy.cancellation_reason: optional up to 500 characters; guest and organizer only; excluded from outbound integrations

booking_link_access.expiresAt: nullable UTC epoch milliseconds; closes at equality
booking_link_access.singleUse: boolean; consumed by first durable new booking request
booking_link_access.consumption: atomic with admission; persists after cancellation, failure, cleanup and toggles
booking_link_access.accepted_bookings: replay, recovery and authorized management/rescheduling continue after public closure

data_export.consistency: per-object revisions; no global atomic snapshot
data_export.excluded: credentials, hashes, management/pixel capabilities, integration secrets and other member private calendar preferences

account_lifecycle_foundations.legacy_credentials: generation 0 while the account is active

account_deletion.authentication: revoked browser and desktop credentials return 401
account_deletion.blockers: owned profiles, connected external calendar grants, future or unresolved bookings, unknown external writes
account_deletion.active_storage_deadline: one calendar month after accepted confirmation
account_deletion.retained: minimal pseudonymous deletion fences and receipts; independent records held by other profiles
